note: Keys are catalog episode file names: the last segment of the archive URL, decoded, the same string as eps[][4] in catalog.json. While that episode is the one playing, the slideshow shows only these pictures, in order. Every other episode, a station break, and an idle player keep the rooms in scenes/scenes.json, including a season whose dates include today. A picture is a path relative to this folder, or an object with src and optional id, name, and lamp. Lamp fields match scenes.json (feet on a surface, as fractions of the frame). A missing file is left out; if none of an episode's pictures are there, the rooms stay as they are. Add Dimension X and X Minus One art by dropping the files in and adding a key. Do not draw the lamp into the file.
